vars.objective: Find a way through the Whisperwold. (Mags said: don't answer the trees.)
journal: The day before the Kindling. The Hierophant himself is coming to Lanternfall. Mom read my letters.
Port Gale. Tobias went home. Soldiers in black-trimmed armor — Thorne's Own, Bram says — are asking about a black-haired girl. Ilse hid Sable's hair under her shawl.

An innkeeper named Mags hid us from Thorne's Own. Bram told us about his trial — Garrick Thorne called him a coward and sent him to Lanternfall. The soldiers said Sable is to be brought to Aurenne "unharmed".
Old Osric sold Dad his compass, twenty years ago, on the Port Gale pier. He says Mom came across once — and danced till dawn. Mom.
We found Bettany's cat. Sable held him for ten minutes. She says she would like to purr. Ilse says please don't.
A hermit named Hesketh, who used to keep the Gull Light, fed us stew and showed us a goat path around the soldiers. He says the light tells you what you are — not what you'll do about it.
The Whisperwold. The trees talk with the voices of dead people. Sable says they're like the voices she heard in the sea, before she washed up. She wasn't scared. I was.
A voice in the trees at the overlook said "west, always west." It's a common enough thing to say. It's a common enough thing to say.

c2_cat.title: Admiral Whiskers
c2_cat.desc: Found him behind the barrels. Return the Admiral to Bettany at the fish market.

c2_lamp.title: The Lamp in the Window
c2_lamp.desc: Jory's voice spoke by the black pond: the knot was his fault; Odile should sell the boat, and sleep. Tell Odile in Port Gale.

c2_cairn.title: Marit's Ring
c2_cairn.desc: Hesketh buried his late wife's ring under the third cairn on the cove, west of the goat path. He wants someone to wear it in the light.

c2_merry.title: Hide and Seek
c2_merry.desc: Merry's secret place is her own grave. The Hollow Mother keeps her in the wold, playing the same summer forever.

point.objective: Find a way through the Whisperwold. (Mags said: don't answer the trees.)
